  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent lows).",
    "Reduce forecast volatility after sharp spikes; model tends to overreact and overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 15-day average, pull down by 5-10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes multiple 0.00 entries followed by a spike — model often fails to anticipate reversal.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, reduce forecast magnitude if sentiment history shows no positive momentum (e.g., all 0.00s).",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50 or 0.67, model tends to overestimate upward movement — apply 10-15% downward correction.",
    "If forecast is consistently above true outcome over 3 consecutive days, apply a 5-10% downward adjustment to prevent overconfidence bias."
  ]
}
